annotations.text:
Several objectives at once, several entries per day.
One is fixed-weekday, one is flexible-weekly, one is off today — all three states visible.

The schedule builder. Everything on the right is derived — planned days, target hours, review date.
Adding a third objective while two run asks for a reason, and records it.

Chosen vs drifted, with the reasoning captured at the time.
The review tests that reasoning against what happened.
Unchanged except that ideas are now global rather than tied to one objective.

The attendance strip is the schedule made visible — met, short, missed, off, and off-but-worked.
The history table compares each day against its target.

Adherence is the headline, ahead of streak.
Deviations split by kind; chosen ones get a was-it-worth-it verdict looking back.
